questions.q: In 'The Ass in the Lion's Skin', what did the Ass dress himself in?
choices: A Lion's skin left by a hunter
A Fox's coat he found in a thicket
Some sheep's wool from the farm
A farmer's old clothes and hat
questions.evidence: An Ass found a Lion's skin left in the forest by a hunter.

questions.q: In 'The Ass in the Lion's Skin', how did the Ass give himself away?
choices: He let out a loud, harsh bray
His long ears stuck out of the skin
He tripped over the long Lion skin
He stopped to eat some green grass

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Ass in the Lion's Skin'?
choices: A fool's words will soon show what he really is
Always wear nice clothes so others will respect you
Foxes are always afraid of lions in the forest
Never hide in a thicket when others are near
questions.evidence: his words will soon show what he really is

questions.q: In 'The Fisherman and the Little Fish', why did the little Fish want to be thrown back?
choices: He said he would make a better meal when bigger
He wanted to swim back and find his mother
He said he was too sick to be good to eat
He promised to bring the Fisherman gold
questions.evidence: When I am bigger, I shall make you a much better meal.

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Fisherman and the Little Fish'?
choices: A small gain is worth more than a large promise
Always throw the little fish back into the sea
Fishermen are greedy and catch too many fish
Big fish are much harder to catch than little ones
questions.evidence: A small gain is worth more than a large promise.

questions.q: In 'The Fighting Cocks and the Eagle', what did the winning Cock do after the fight?
choices: Flew to the top of the hen-house and crowed
Hid in a corner of the yard to rest his wounds
Went to sleep in the barn after the fight
Shared his food with the other beaten Cock
questions.evidence: crowed with all his might to tell the world about his victory

questions.q: In 'The Fighting Cocks and the Eagle', the Eagle carried off the boasting Cock. What is the lesson?
choices: Pride goes before a fall
Eagles are kind to Cocks
Never fight with a friend
The strongest always wins
